referenceClass.cpuAndExactOsModels: to be fixed in the native measurement protocol before any pass claim; use a representative supported laptop class

testWorkload.fixtureDetail: exact expressions, dependency shapes and data seeds must be fixed before measurement

resourceTargets.include: all calculator-owned shell, core and helper/renderer processes; use a documented platform memory metric consistently
resourceTargets.meaning: acceptance budgets, not permission to delete data or terminate the app to meet a quota

measurementProtocol.foregroundLoad: ordinary idle desktop, without debugger or concurrent compilation
measurementProtocol.warmInvoke: palette starts hidden with app resident; finish when input is visibly ready and focused
measurementProtocol.ordinaryRecalculation: latest edit to current ready answer paint, including dispatch and rendering
measurementProtocol.coldStartup: application process start to normal input readiness; user-controlled OS security and first-run permission dialogs measured separately
measurementProtocol.sampling: at least 100 runs for interactive latency, 20 for cold start; record all values and p95, not only the best run
measurementProtocol.resources: steady idle over 60 seconds after startup tasks, and settled representative active sheet; document aggregation to avoid counting unrelated processes
unknowns: exact reference machine models and OS builds
full watchdog and error attribution design
measurementProtocol.correctnessGate: Reference workloads must produce the expected complete results. A fast error, skipped expression or incomplete set of meanings is not a successful latency sample.
measurementProtocol.status: engineering protocol outline; exact devices, fixtures and platform counters remain to be fixed

availableEnvironmentFact.osNameNote: registry ProductName differs from the release/build; preserve the observed facts rather than claim a tested OS name
availableEnvironmentFact.method: read-only registry and .NET ComputerInfo by the research agent; no network discovery
availableEnvironmentFact.baselineCaution: this 32-GiB development machine does not by itself validate the accepted 8-GiB reference class

verificationBoundary: Round 36 performance and resource targets are accepted. No production calculator benchmark or native compatibility test has been run; exact protocol details still require engineering work.

deadline.scope: one evaluation request for the current expression or affected active-sheet region, including parse, dependencies and lazy meanings
deadline.onExceeded: terminate that request and show a concise complexity diagnostic for unfinished affected expressions; preserve editable input and already-complete independent results
deadline.resultCompleteness: a ready expression result includes all valid meanings; deadline does not authorize a truncated subset presented as complete
deadline.staleRequest: superseded work must not replace or diagnose the newer input
deadline.enforcementMechanism: architecture decision; deterministic work limits and the elapsed-time guard must be designed together
